title: setup hook --harness pi writes the generated Pi extension .pi/extensions/jitso-guard.js
source: intended: setup hook for every harness (claude, codex, opencode, pi): one plan, one preview, one confirmation and one backup
intent: INTENDED behavior. Pi loads `.pi/extensions/*.js` (default export `function (pi)`), so jitso writes a generated file with its marker line that handles `tool_call` (bash becomes `Bash`, other tool names pass as they are; a deny returns `{ block: true, reason }`) and `session_shutdown` (a SessionEnd input whose answer is ignored). A second run is nothing to do.

regex: ^// generated by jitso \S+: jitso setup hook; do not edit

stdout.equals: jitso setup hook: nothing to do (the guard is already registered in .pi/extensions/jitso-guard.js)
